categories.title: Categories
categories.text: Group products the way cashiers look for them.
categories.emptyText: Add the groups cashiers look for, like Tops or Drinks.
categories.parentHint: Leave empty for a top-level category.
categories.sortHint: Lower numbers appear first on the POS. 0 or more.
categories.visibleText: Show this category on the POS and in product lists.
categories.nameRequired: Enter the category name in English.
categories.duplicate: A category with this name already exists.

units.title: Units
units.text: How each product is counted when you sell or stock it.
units.emptyText: Add how you count products, like Piece or Kilogram.
units.name: Name
units.fractionsText: Allow quantities like 0.5 kg. Leave off for things sold whole, like pieces.
units.scaleOn: With fractions on, cashiers can sell quantities like 0.5 kg.
units.scaleOff: With fractions off, cashiers sell whole quantities like 1 pc.
units.symbolTaken: This symbol is already used by another unit.
units.failed: We couldn’t save. Check your connection and try again.

taxRates.text: Vendora doesn’t suggest rates. Enter the ones your business is registered for.

taxRates.emptyText: Add the rates your business is registered for.
taxRates.name: Name
taxRates.nameHint: As it should appear on receipts.
taxRates.rateHint: Between 0 and 100. Use the rate your business is registered for.
taxRates.defaultText: New products start with this rate. Only one rate can be the default.
